name: SEOHub
desc: An all-in-one enterprise SEO platform that audits, fixes, and monitors website search performance. Features include crawl analysis, keyword research via Gemini AI, accessibility scanning, PageSpeed insights, and competitor comparison.

name: CyberStrike Suite
desc: A web-based monitoring dashboard designed to simulate security check scenarios and visualize real-time request metrics.

name: Rebuildly
desc: Rebuildly audits websites for code quality, design, and accessibility. It provides actionable insights to developers.

name: Invenscope
desc: AI-powered patent analyzer that scans global registries, evaluates novelty using vector embeddings, and generates novel invention combinations.

name: Axiogen AI
desc: Core neural network training workspace powering predictive analytics and cognitive assistant agents.

name: RansomGuard AI
desc: Real-time ransomware detection and response engine powered by watchdog traps, entropy analysis, and an ML ensemble.

name: OmniDx
desc: Advanced medical X-ray pathology classification using DenseNet121 and Grad-CAM visual heatmaps for explainability.

name: CodeWeaver AI
desc: AI system that auto-generates production-ready code, tests, and full project structures from natural language specifications.

name: TruthLens

name: Blockchain Forge
desc: High-performance cryptographic sandbox tool for generating, mining, and auditing distributed chains.

name: NAAC Platform
desc: Advanced academic accreditation suite streamlining documentation, criteria metrics, and reporting.

name: SessionWarden
desc: Active session protection agent intercepting hijack attempts and managing token rotation in real-time.

name: Lumina Backgrounds
desc: Library of fluid particle simulations and interactive canvas shaders built for premium web graphics.
